blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it

findings.recommendation: Sum `total_cents` over the invoices already loaded by `invoices_of_month` instead of running `month_total`, which re-reads every invoice of the month (one extra aggregate query per report, growing with the month's invoices). This also makes the total consistent with the listed lines; confirm finance expects the total of the listed lines before changing it.
findings.title: The month total costs a second scan of the month's invoices

findings.recommendation: Weigh the dependency's cost (compile time, binary size, transitive `regex-syntax`/`aho-corasick`/`memchr`) against matching `PO-\d{4}-\d{4}` by hand — scan for `PO-` and check the 4 + `-` + 4 ASCII digits that follow — or record in the proposal why the crate is worth it.
findings.title: The `regex` crate is added for one fixed-shape pattern

findings.recommendation: Build the "Name (country)" label once per customer when filling the map (about 800 per month) and clone it per line, instead of a `format!` per invoice (about 3 000 per month); or keep as is given the small volumes.
findings.title: The customer label is formatted once per invoice, not once per customer

findings.recommendation: Iterate `invoices` by value (`into_iter()`) and move `number` into the line, avoiding one `String` copy per invoice.
findings.title: Invoice numbers are cloned while the invoices are dropped right after

findings.recommendation: The report reads every invoice of the month (about 3 000 today, growing with sales) in one result, with no `LIMIT` or streaming, through `SELECT … FROM invoices WHERE month = $1 ORDER BY number` (src/db.rs:21), which filters and sorts on `invoices.month`/`number`; the schema is not in the repository, so check with `EXPLAIN` that an index on `(month, number)` serves both, and decide whether a bound or streaming is needed as volumes grow.
findings.title: The month's invoices are loaded without a bound, on a filter whose index is not visible
